note: Part SK's problems (records/revision.md): the project's own synthetic task, rebuilt by src/common/skill. splits(task, size) draws one stream of problems per setting from random.Random('skill-20260926:<task>:<size>'), drops repeats, and cuts the stream into 300 calibration, 300 evaluation and 4,480 train problems; each problem's worked solutions are ordered by random.Random('skill-20260926:<task_id>'). Listed, in order: the calibration problems of every setting of the ladder (the smoke used the first 5 of each), and the evaluation and train problems of base7-5, the setting the calibration chose. A base7 id spells out its two numbers; a words id is the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of '<alphabet>:<words, comma-separated>'. Equal to the run's smoke-cap4096/, smoke-cap8192/, calibration/, eval/ and arms.json (runs/skill/skill-20260926).
